name: DownloadTrigger
purpose: Present an Atom-backed generated-file download as a finished Button.
useWhen: A user downloads application-generated text or binary data.

avoidWhen.condition: A downloadable resource already has a URL.

composition: Supply data, fileName, mimeType for string data and visible children. Lazy producers receive AbortSignal. Use normal Button size, tone, variant and startIcon/endIcon props. FormatByte can describe a known file size separately.

rules.statement: Use the shared token-only radius contract only on the public parts listed in docs/guides/radius.md. Omit it to retain the owner default; do not combine it with legacy corner shape or forward it to native elements. Core names and semantic roles are distinct; popup boundaries are independent of their triggers.
Keep transport, serializers, authentication and translated error messages in the application. A data string is literal file content, never a URL.
Handle onDownloadError. onDownloadInitiated means browser handoff, not a completed save.
Load styles.css or core.css plus download-trigger.css, which includes Button styles. Do not duplicate Button geometry.
Support scalar focusRing="outside" | "inside"; omission stays outside. Inside uses paired foreground and canonical negative-width offset without changing Atom behavior.

commonMistakes.mistake: Replacing every existing download link with generated-file JavaScript.
commonMistakes.correction: Use this owner only for generated data; keep native links and server streaming for existing/large files.

validation: Verify exact bytes and filename, asynchronous pending/error recovery, cancellation, labels, icon/size parity, loading, keyboard and browser restrictions.
